sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The victim joined the proceeding through V.C. being facilitated by the IIC, Mr. S.K. Sahoo,
Kashinagar Police Station.
3. On being asked the victim opposes the grant of bail.

4. The petitioner is an accused in connection with G.R. Case No.23 of 2022, pending in the Court of the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Paralakhemundi, Gajapati, arising out of Kashinagar P.S.
Case No. 93 of 2022, for commission of alleged offences under Sections 376(2)(n)/376(3)/506 of IPC read with Section 6 of POCSO Act.

5. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Additional S.J.-cum-Spl. Judge, Paralakhemundi by order dated 21.12.2022 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
6. Perused the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim.
7. Considering that the accused was a tuition teacher, this Court is not inclined to entertain this bail application at this stage notwithstanding the medical examination report.
